_how_to_edit: This file is the Recent Works gallery. Each entry below is one framed piece on the site, shown in this order. To add a piece: drop the photo into assets/ and copy one of the blocks below with the new filename, title, tag (small label like 'colour' or 'black & grey'), caption (shown in the enlarged view) and alt (a one-line description for screen readers). To remove or reorder pieces, delete or move their blocks. No other part of the website needs to change.
